notifications.title: Agent cloud environment is missing the renderer's Python packages
notifications.detail: Still true on 2026-10-19: in today's Scout session `python -m generator.run state --format long` crashed with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'PIL'` until I ran `python -m pip install -r renderer/requirements.txt`. Scout works around it, but Studio and the video runs depend on the same command.
notifications.fix: 1. In claude.ai/code, open this repo's cloud environment settings. 2. Add `python -m pip install -q -r renderer/requirements.txt` to its setup script, or check that the existing setup script runs it. 3. Start a new session and check that `python -m generator.run state` runs.
